title: Set up WhatsApp safely and lock your account

say: Set up WhatsApp safely, and lock your account.
This is the video for module one of WhatsApp for Communication and Business.
Your WhatsApp account is tied to one phone number. That number becomes your identity, so choose a line you plan to keep for years.
First, install the genuine app, and nothing else.

panel.heading: Your number is your WhatsApp identity
items: Install the genuine app only
Never share your six-digit code
Turn on two-step verification
Back up so you never lose chats

say: Next, you will see why the six-digit code that comes by SMS must never leave your hands.

say: Then you will switch on two-step verification, the most important setting in WhatsApp.

say: And you will back up your chats, so a lost phone does not take your customers with it.

say: Only install WhatsApp from the Google Play Store on Android, or the App Store on iPhone. Check that the developer is WhatsApp LLC.
Keep it updated for security fixes.

panel.heading: Official app or a trap?
left: Google Play Store or App Store

say: Never install copies passed around as files, such as GB WhatsApp. They are not made by WhatsApp, they can steal your messages, and WhatsApp can ban accounts that use them.
If you have one, back up what you need, uninstall it, and install the official app.

panel.heading: Official app or a trap?
left: Google Play Store or App Store

say: Two-step verification adds a six-digit PIN that you create. Then anyone trying to register your number on a new phone needs the SMS code and your PIN.
Step one. Open Settings, then Account, then Two-step verification.

panel.heading: Turn on two-step verification
items: Open Settings, Account, Two-step verification
Tap Turn on and create a six-digit PIN
Type the PIN again to confirm
Add an email address you can open
Write the PIN on paper, kept safe at home

say: Step two. Tap Turn on and type a six-digit PIN you will remember. Do not use your birthday, 123456, or your ATM PIN.

panel.heading: Turn on two-step verification
items: Open Settings, Account, Two-step verification
Tap Turn on and create a six-digit PIN
Type the PIN again to confirm
Add an email address you can open
Write the PIN on paper, kept safe at home

say: Step three. Type it again to confirm.

panel.heading: Turn on two-step verification
items: Open Settings, Account, Two-step verification
Tap Turn on and create a six-digit PIN
Type the PIN again to confirm
Add an email address you can open
Write the PIN on paper, kept safe at home

say: Step four. Add an email address you can open. WhatsApp uses it to send you a reset link if you forget the PIN.

panel.heading: Turn on two-step verification
items: Open Settings, Account, Two-step verification
Tap Turn on and create a six-digit PIN
Type the PIN again to confirm
Add an email address you can open
Write the PIN on paper, kept safe at home

say: Step five. Write the PIN somewhere safe at home, not in your phone notes.
And remember the rule. Your SMS code is like your ATM PIN. WhatsApp will never call or message you to ask for it.

panel.rule: Never share your SMS code or your PIN with anyone, ever.

say: Here is how the trick works. Chioma in Owerri sells hair products. One evening a message comes from her cousin's account.
It says, I mistakenly sent my code to your number, please send it to me.

panel.heading: A near miss: the code trick
items: Message from her cousin's account asks for a code
An SMS code arrives at the same moment
She does not send it; she calls her cousin
She turns on two-step verification

say: At the same moment, an SMS with a six-digit code arrives. Chioma recognises the pattern. Someone is trying to register her number on another phone, and her cousin's account has probably already been hijacked.

panel.heading: A near miss: the code trick
items: Message from her cousin's account asks for a code
An SMS code arrives at the same moment
She does not send it; she calls her cousin
She turns on two-step verification

say: She does not send the code. She calls her cousin on a normal phone call, and the cousin says she sent no message.

panel.heading: A near miss: the code trick
items: Message from her cousin's account asks for a code
An SMS code arrives at the same moment
She does not send it; she calls her cousin
She turns on two-step verification

say: Then Chioma turns on two-step verification with a new PIN and her email. Her account stays safe.

panel.rule: WhatsApp will never ask you for your code.

say: Now open Settings, Privacy. My contacts means people saved in your phone. For last seen and online, choose My contacts or Nobody.

panel.heading: Who can see what
items: Last seen and online: My contacts or Nobody
Profile photo: My contacts
Status: My contacts
Groups: My contacts, to stop scam groups
Silence unknown callers: On

say: Set your profile photo to My contacts, and avoid photos of your children.

panel.heading: Who can see what
items: Last seen and online: My contacts or Nobody
Profile photo: My contacts
Status: My contacts
Groups: My contacts, to stop scam groups
Silence unknown callers: On

say: Set your status to My contacts, so strangers do not follow your daily life.

panel.heading: Who can see what
items: Last seen and online: My contacts or Nobody
Profile photo: My contacts
Status: My contacts
Groups: My contacts, to stop scam groups
Silence unknown callers: On

say: This one matters most. Set Groups to My contacts. It stops strangers adding you to investment, crypto or forex trading groups, one of the most common ways scams begin.

panel.heading: Who can see what
items: Last seen and online: My contacts or Nobody
Profile photo: My contacts
Status: My contacts
Groups: My contacts, to stop scam groups
Silence unknown callers: On

say: If you get spam calls, switch on Silence unknown callers. Calls from unsaved numbers then go to your call list without ringing.

say: Your messages live on your phone, not on WhatsApp's servers. If the phone is stolen and you have no backup, the chats are gone.
Open Settings, Chats, Chat backup.

panel.heading: Back up your chats
items: Open Settings, Chats, Chat backup
Link Google Drive, or iCloud on iPhone
Choose daily or weekly backup
Back up on Wi-Fi to save your bundle
Tap Back up now and check the time shown

say: On Android, link your Google account. On iPhone, the backup goes to iCloud.

panel.heading: Back up your chats
items: Open Settings, Chats, Chat backup
Link Google Drive, or iCloud on iPhone
Choose daily or weekly backup
Back up on Wi-Fi to save your bundle
Tap Back up now and check the time shown

say: Set the frequency to daily or weekly. Videos make the backup large, so decide whether to include them.

panel.heading: Back up your chats
items: Open Settings, Chats, Chat backup
Link Google Drive, or iCloud on iPhone

Back up on Wi-Fi to save your bundle
Tap Back up now and check the time shown

say: Many people back up only on Wi-Fi, to save their data bundle.

panel.heading: Back up your chats
items: Open Settings, Chats, Chat backup
Link Google Drive, or iCloud on iPhone
Choose daily or weekly backup

Tap Back up now and check the time shown

say: Tap Back up now, and check the screen shows the time as just now. When Bisi in Ibadan moved to a new phone, she signed in to the same Google account and tapped Restore. Her customers' chats all came back.

say: To remember. Install only the official app. Never share the six-digit code or your PIN. Turn on two-step verification with your email. Set Groups to My contacts. And switch on backup before you need it.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Install only from Play Store or App Store
Never share the six-digit code or your PIN
Two-step verification PIN plus email
Set Groups to My contacts
Switch on chat backup before you need it

say: Now pick up your phone. Check your app is official and updated, run Privacy checkup, turn on two-step verification, and run one backup on Wi-Fi.
Take a screenshot showing two-step verification is on, without the PIN, and continue with the lessons below.

panel.heading: Lock down your account today
items: Check your app is official and updated
Run Privacy checkup
Turn on two-step verification
Run one backup on Wi-Fi
